caption.text:
Sebanyak 27 orang tewas dalam kebakaran besar di sebuah bar di Bangkok, Thailand pada Minggu (12/7).

Kebakaran itu juga menyebabkan setidaknya 63 orang dirawat di rumah sakit karena luka-luka, termasuk 22 kritis.

Petugas mengatakan sejumlah korban tewas ditemukan di dekat pintu keluar darurat.

Menurut keterangan saksi, asap muncul dari pemutus sirkuit di dekat panggung kemudian diikuti pemadaman listrik dan ledakan.

Simak selengkapnya di cnnindonesia.com.
(🎥 REUTERS) 

#cnnindonesia #cnnindonesiacom #Peristiwa
caption.text_translation:
As many as 27 people died in a massive fire at a bar in Bangkok, Thailand on Sunday (12/7).

The fire also left at least 63 people hospitalized for injuries, including 22 critical.

Officials say a number of fatalities were found near the emergency exit.

According to witnesses, smoke emerged from a circuit breaker near the stage then followed by a power outage and explosion.

Check out more on cnnindonesia.com .
 (🎥 REUTERS)
